zh: 桌面底栏与宠物窗口额度趋势图交互精简：优化额度消耗时间曲线样式，移除交互探测点的悬停灰点与连续折线末端冗余圆点，仅对孤立单点保留打点，提升曲线干净度与观感。
右侧浏览器 AI 指针群协同实时绘制画布：普通对话流式生成 HTML 网页或写入 .html 文件时，自动展开右侧浏览器启动 10 位多彩专业 AI 指针特工，提供 60fps 丝滑轨迹与增量 DOM 渲染预览。
内置浏览器远程下载管理：支持在远程/网页端内置浏览器中捕获、查看并一键保存已完成的文件下载，下载按钮提供实时状态徽标提醒。
智能体工具权限收敛与状态联动：WeLink 频道消息（机器人推送）纳入团队默认关闭策略，与平台共享 MCP 保持一致；当底层频道未启用时自动对非超管隐藏，超管后台清晰标明连接状态。
WorkBuddy 桌面连接器会话解析增强：修复桌面智能体遇到字符串等非数组格式消息时报错中断的问题，自适应兼容多种原生会话结构与历史解析。
en: Desktop quota bar & pet trend chart visual refinement: streamlined quota consumption curves by removing hover-point fills and redundant segment endpoints, marking only isolated points for a cleaner look.

Right Browser AI Cursor Swarm Live HTML Painter: in standard chats, streaming HTML generation or .html file writes automatically open the right-hand browser with 10 specialized colorful AI cursor agents.
Built-in browser remote download management: captures completed file downloads in the remote browser view with status indicators and one-click local saving.

Agent tool access hardening & channel status linking: WeLink channel messaging (bot push) is now off for teams by default alongside shared MCP; tools are hidden from non-super admins when the channel is disabled.
WorkBuddy desktop connector session resilience: fixed conversation crashes caused by non-array teammate messages, adapting seamlessly across varied native chat structures.
